abstract: Ferricyanide bleach is used by many photographic processing laboratories because of its high bleaching efficiency and its capacity for regeneration. This report describes a low-cost electrolytic method for bleach regeneration that reduces operating costs and lowers ferricyanide waste by 30 percent. This improved regeneration method enables a photographic processing laboratory to more easily meet effluent regulations.
